title: Mother Bottle-Feeding Baby Outdoors, 1939 Regina Canada Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
The afternoon is
an "fussy" time &
a bottle of water
sometimes helps!

CHICAGO POSTAL PHOTO SUPPLIES
REGINA, SASK.
JUN 26 1939
description: A heartfelt candid outdoor snapshot showing a well-dressed mother in a dark tailored suit jacket, patterned scarf, eyeglasses, and stylish tilted pillbox hat holding and bottle-feeding her swaddled newborn baby. The background features a residential home and lush garden yard. A developer stamp on the back dates the processing to June 26, 1939, in Regina, Saskatchewan.
